US Bans Chinese AI Tools from Government Systems

The United States government has banned the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools developed by the Chinese startup DeepSeek by its agencies. The Department of Defense stated that the use of these tools could result in the transfer of sensitive data to China. This action comes amid a broader competition between the US and China for dominance in the AI sector.
